summary: Full-stack testing of FixMyCity completed. Backend pytest: 25/26 passed (1 test-code bug fixed - email lowercased server-side). Frontend E2E: landing → auth (demo login citizen/admin/worker), feed cards+filter+upvote toggle, report flow with real photo upload → AI scan overlay → AI classify result (source=ai for road/garbage/streetlight seeds with 93-99% confidence, correct categories) → submit → redirect /my with +10 points, My Reports timeline, Map (23 Leaflet markers), Leaderboard, Admin dashboard (4 count-up metric cards + 14 recharts + 23 complaints table + assign worker with deadline → status Assigned + timeline updates), role guard (citizen→/admin redirected to /feed), Mobile 390px viewport with bottom nav 5 items and no horizontal overflow. All core requirements from the review request pass.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> child inside disabled <option> element. Root cause is Emergent dev-mode source-instrumentation wrapping the option's text label in a span wrapper (x-source-editable). Not user-visible, disappears in production build. Safe to ignore or wrap option text with plain string only.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: CORSMiddleware is added AFTER app.include_router, which is acceptable in Starlette but stylistically it is preferred before route registration.
server.py: /api/uploads is a StaticFiles mount that is NOT protected by auth — any uploaded photo URL is world-readable. Acceptable for civic-issue photos but flag if privacy is a concern.
server.py test seams: verify_password will raise on unicode edge cases only; fine for now.
upvote endpoint silently no-ops if user tries to upvote their own issue (returns 200). Consider returning 400 to clarify UX, but current behavior is acceptable.
Feed.jsx: the disabled <option value='nearest'> reportedly emits hydration warning due to dev instrumentation — no runtime impact but slightly noisy console.
test_credentials: Used /app/memory/test_credentials.md as-is; all admin/citizen/worker logins verified.
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_-prefixed issues via /api/issues (garbage, workflow, pothole) for E2E flows. DB is mutated (one workflow issue was moved Pending→Assigned→In Progress→Resolved by worker1). Baseline seed of 20 issues is intact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All happy-path flows and role guards verified. AI classify with EMERGENT_LLM_KEY returns source='ai' for seed photos (road1→roads 0.99, garbage1→sanitation 0.98, streetlight2→electricity 0.93). Note that streetlight2.jpg is classified as 'electricity' by the LLM (arguably correct given the photo content). If future tests require deterministic 'streetlights' output, use a clearer streetlight image or seed the description. Auth uses Bearer JWT (7d) stored in localStorage key fmc_token. Backend BASE_URL from /app/frontend/.env is https://report-resolve-24.preview.emergentagent.com. Pytest command: `cd /app && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... python -m pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`.
